passages.text: A long time after the LORD had given Israel rest from all the enemies around them, when Joshua was old and well along in years, he summoned all Israel, including its elders, leaders, judges, and officers. “I am old and well along in years,” he said, “and you have seen everything that the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake, because it was the LORD your God who fought for you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave Israel rest from all their enemies around them.
Many years passed.
Joshua became old.
Joshua was advanced in years.
Joshua called for all Israel.
He called the elders of Israel.
He called the leaders of Israel.
He called the judges of Israel.
He called the officers of Israel.
Joshua spoke to them.
He said, “I am old.
I am advanced in years.
You have seen everything the LORD your God has done.
The LORD did these things to all these nations for your sake.
The LORD your God fought for you.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִיָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר־ הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֧ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִכָּל־ אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִֽים׃ וַיִּקְרָ֤א יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ לְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִזְקֵנָיו֙ וּלְרָאשָׁ֔יו וּלְשֹׁפְטָ֖יו וּלְשֹֽׁטְרָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אֲנִ֣י זָקַ֔נְתִּי בָּ֖אתִי בַּיָּמִֽים׃ וְאַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֗ם אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם לְכָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֖וּא הַנִּלְחָ֥ם לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: See, I have allotted as an inheritance to your tribes these remaining nations, including all the nations I have already cut off, from the Jordan westward to the Great Sea.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
\r\nJoshua spoke to all the people of Israel.
\r\nJoshua said, “Look and see.
\r\nI have given you these nations that still remain.
\r\nI have given them to your tribes as an inheritance.
\r\nI have already destroyed some nations for you.
\r\nThese nations are from the Jordan River to the west.
\r\nThey reach all the way to the Great Sea, where the sun sets.”
passages.original: רְאוּ֩ הִפַּ֨לְתִּי לָכֶ֜ם אֶֽת־ הַ֠גּוֹיִם הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֛לֶּה בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן וְכָל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְרַ֔תִּי וְהַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל מְב֥וֹא הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃

passages.text: The LORD your God will push them out of your way and drive them out before you, so that you can take possession of their land, as the LORD your God promised you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD will push these nations out of your way.
The LORD will drive them out from before you.
You will take possession of their land.
The LORD your God promised this to you.
passages.original: וַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם ה֚וּא יֶהְדֳּפֵ֣ם מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם וְהוֹרִ֥ישׁ אֹתָ֖ם מִלִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתֶּם֙ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Be very strong, then, so that you can keep and obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, not turning aside from it to the right or to the left.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel the Law through Moses.
This Law is written in the Book of the Law of Moses.
You must keep everything written in this Book.
You must obey all the commands in it.
Be very strong as you do this.
Do not turn away from the Law.
Do not turn to the right.
Do not turn to the left.
Stay on the path God gave you.
passages.original: וַחֲזַקְתֶּ֣ם מְאֹ֔ד לִשְׁמֹ֣ר וְלַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַכָּת֔וּב בְּסֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֥י סוּר־ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול׃

passages.text: So you are not to associate with these nations that remain among you. You must not call on the names of their gods or swear by them, and you must not serve them or bow down to them.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
Some nations still lived among them.
God told Israel not to join with these nations.
God commanded Israel not to mention the names of these nations' gods.
God commanded Israel not to swear by these gods.
God commanded Israel not to serve these gods.
God commanded Israel not to bow down to these gods.
passages.original: לְבִלְתִּי־ בוֹא֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אִתְּכֶ֑ם וּבְשֵׁ֨ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֤ם לֹא־ תַזְכִּ֙ירוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֔יעוּ וְלֹ֣א תַעַבְד֔וּם וְלֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Instead, you shall hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.
passages.sermon:
You must hold fast to the LORD your God.
You have done this until today.
Continue to stay close to Him.
Do not let go of Him.
Trust in the LORD your God always.
passages.original: כִּ֛י אִם־ בַּיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם תִּדְבָּ֑קוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD has driven out great and powerful nations before you, and to this day no one can stand against you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD has power.
The LORD drove out nations before you.
These nations were great.
These nations were powerful.
No one has stood against you.
This is true until today.
passages.original: וַיּ֤וֹרֶשׁ יְהוָה֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם גּוֹיִ֖ם גְּדֹלִ֣ים וַעֲצוּמִ֑ים וְאַתֶּ֗ם לֹא־ עָ֤מַד אִישׁ֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: One of you can put a thousand to flight, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as He promised.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD fights for you.
The LORD promised to fight for you.
Because of the LORD, one of you can chase a thousand enemies.
The LORD keeps His promises.
passages.original: אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֥ד מִכֶּ֖ם יִרְדָּף־ אָ֑לֶף כִּ֣י׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם ה֚וּא הַנִּלְחָ֣ם לָכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore watch yourselves carefully, that you love the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
You are the people of Israel.
\r\nThe LORD is your God.
\r\nWatch yourselves very carefully.
\r\nMake sure you love the LORD your God.
passages.original: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְנַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֑ם לְאַהֲבָ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For if you turn away and cling to the rest of these nations that remain among you, and if you intermarry and associate with them, know for sure that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become for you a snare and a trap, a scourge in your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land that the LORD your God has given you.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
He gave you this good land.
Some nations still remain among you.
If you turn away from God, you will cling to these nations.
If you join with them, you will intermarry with them.
If you associate with them, they will associate with you.
Know this for certain.
The LORD your God will not drive out these nations before you anymore.
These nations will become a snare to you.
They will become a trap for you.
They will trouble your sides.
They will be thorns in your eyes.
This will continue until you perish from this good land.
The LORD your God gave you this land.
passages.original: כִּ֣י׀ אִם־ שׁ֣וֹב תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ וּדְבַקְתֶּם֙ בְּיֶ֙תֶר֙ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְהִֽתְחַתַּנְתֶּ֥ם בָּהֶ֛ם וּבָאתֶ֥ם בָּהֶ֖ם וְהֵ֥ם בָּכֶֽם׃ יָד֙וֹעַ֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוֹסִ֜יף יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם לְהוֹרִ֛ישׁ אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם לְפַ֣ח וּלְמוֹקֵ֗שׁ וּלְשֹׁטֵ֤ט בְּצִדֵּיכֶם֙ וְלִצְנִנִ֣ים בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֔ם עַד־ אֲבָדְכֶ֗ם מֵ֠עַל הָאֲדָמָ֤ה הַטּוֹבָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Now behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know with all your heart and soul that not one of the good promises the LORD your God made to you has failed. Everything was fulfilled for you; not one promise has failed.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua spoke to the people.
Joshua said, “Today I am about to die.
I will go the way of all the earth.
You know this with all your heart.
You know this with all your soul.
The LORD your God made good promises to you.
Not one of these promises has failed.
Every promise has come true for you.
Not one promise has failed.”
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י הוֹלֵךְ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וִידַעְתֶּ֞ם בְּכָל־ לְבַבְכֶ֣ם וּבְכָל־ נַפְשְׁכֶ֗ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא־ נָפַל֩ דָּבָ֨ר אֶחָ֜ד מִכֹּ֣ל׀ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הַטּוֹבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם הַכֹּל֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָכֶ֔ם לֹֽא־ נָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ דָּבָ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: But just as every good thing the LORD your God promised you has come to pass, likewise the LORD will bring upon you the calamity He has threatened, until He has destroyed you from this good land He has given you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD promised you many good things.
Every good thing the LORD promised has come to you.
The LORD kept every promise.
In the same way, the LORD will bring every bad thing He warned about.
The LORD will do this if you turn away from Him.
The LORD will bring trouble upon you.
He will do this until He destroys you from this good land.
The LORD your God gave you this land.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤א עֲלֵיכֶם֙ כָּל־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם כֵּן֩ יָבִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַדָּבָ֣ר הָרָ֔ע עַד־ הַשְׁמִיד֣וֹ אוֹתְכֶ֗ם מֵ֠עַל הָאֲדָמָ֤ה הַטּוֹבָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: If you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from this good land He has given you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He gave you His covenant.
He commanded you to keep it.
If you break this covenant,
and if you go and serve other gods,
and if you bow down to them,
then the LORD will become angry with you.
His anger will burn against you.
He will remove you quickly from this good land.
He gave you this land.
You will perish from it.
passages.original: בְּ֠עָבְרְכֶם אֶת־ בְּרִ֨ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶם֒ וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶ֑ם וְחָרָ֤ה אַף־ יְהוָה֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֔ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר נָתַ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃פ
